name: How long does a typical peeling paint repair job take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical peeling paint repair job take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a peeling paint repair job depends on the size of the area, the severity of the peeling, and weather conditions for exterior projects. A small interior wall section might take less than a day, while an entire exterior house with significant peeling could take several days to over a week. This includes time for scraping, sanding, cleaning, priming, and applying multiple paint coats, factoring in drying times. Professionals work efficiently, but quality work requires adequate time for each stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Job duration varies from less than a day for small areas to over a week for large exteriors, depending on severity and weather.
